title: Barbara Fedders

body:
# Barbara Fedders

# Barbara Fedders (D)

# Vice-Chair

![](/media/uploads/2025/12/fedders.jpg)

- Author of **[a journal article](https://scholarship.law.unc.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1060&context=faculty_publications)**: *Coming out for kids: Recognizing, respecting, and representing LGBTQ youth.*In her article, she advocates keeping gender identity and sexuality secrets from parents.
- Fedders **[supports](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4935674)** “gender-affirming care” for youth.
